formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) → (∀ j < C.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (∀ p : Fin N, (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun kf : Fin (N + N) => decide (kf = Fin.castAdd N p)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ ∀ l : Fin N, (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun kg : Fin (N + N) => decide (kg = Fin.natAdd N l)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 D ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) D ∧ D.size ≤ C.size ∧ (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) D z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) ∧ (∀ j < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ p0 l0 : Fin N, ¬ I p0 l0 → (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun ke : Fin (N + N) => decide (ke = Fin.castAdd N p0 ∨ ke = Fin.natAdd N l0)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ (∀ j < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (∀ p : Fin N, (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun kc : Fin (N + N) => decide (kc = Fin.castAdd N p)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ ∀ l : Fin N, (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun kd : Fin (N + N) => decide (kd = Fin.natAdd N l)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false))
plain_statement: The negation of: for N points and N lines with no two points on two common lines, every AND/OR fan-in-two circuit computing the incidence function whose ANDs are false at every one-hot input has one no larger, also computing it, whose ANDs are false at every one-hot input and at every input of one point and one line not incident.
title: It is false that a 4-cycle-free incidence circuit with ANDs off at one-hot inputs always has a no-larger one whose ANDs are also off at non-incident pairs
